import ctypes as ct
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import numpy as np

root=Path.cwd();p=root/'scratch/glm-vq'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gate',root/'tests/test_glm_vq_q4k.py')
gate=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(gate)
model=Path('/home/sunghoon/workspace/ds4-exaone/models/GLM-5.3-Flash-VQ-Q4K-KDA-GGUF')
records=json.loads((model/'tensor-manifest.json').read_text())['tensors']
lib=p/'libq4_refine.so';fn=ct.CDLL(str(lib)).bench_q4_refine
fn.argtypes=[ct.c_void_p]*3+[ct.c_uint32]*5+[ct.POINTER(ct.c_float)];fn.restype=ct.c_int
results=[]
for suffix,input_name in [('q_proj','input_layernorm'),('o_proj','self_attn.o_norm')]:
 name=f'model.language_model.layers.0.self_attn.{suffix}.weight'
 t=next(t for t in records if t['name']==name); rows,cols=t['shape']
 with (model/t['part']).open('rb') as f:
  _,entries,base=gate.q4.read_header(f);e=next(e for e in entries if e['name']==name)
  f.seek(base+e['offset']);raw=f.read(t['payload_bytes'])
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==t['payload_sha256']
 w=np.frombuffer(raw,np.uint8).copy()
 x=np.fromfile(p/f'layer-fixture/{input_name}.f32',np.float32).reshape(-1,cols)[:1].copy()
 assert x.ctypes.data%16==0
 expected=None
 for iteration,order in enumerate([[0,1,2,3],[3,2,1,0],[0,1,2,3]]):
  for mode in order:
   y=np.empty((1,rows),np.float32);elapsed=ct.c_float()
   assert fn(w.ctypes.data,x.ctypes.data,y.ctypes.data,rows,cols,1,256,mode,ct.byref(elapsed))==0
   assert np.isfinite(y).all()
   if expected is None:expected=y.copy()
   r=dict(matrix=name,shape=[rows,cols],iteration=iteration,mode=mode,ms=elapsed.value,
      bit_equal=bool(np.array_equal(y,expected)),max_error=float(np.max(np.abs(y-expected))),
      matrix_sha256=t['payload_sha256'],input_sha256=hashlib.sha256(x).hexdigest())
   if not r['bit_equal']:
    restored=gate.unpack(raw,rows,cols);ref=x.astype(np.float64)@restored.T
    mag=np.abs(x.astype(np.float64))@np.abs(restored.T);u=2**-24;gamma=(cols+32)*u/(1-(cols+32)*u)
    bound=gamma*mag+np.exp2(np.floor(np.log2(np.maximum(np.abs(ref),2**-126)))-8)+2**-126
    r['max_bound_ratio']=float(np.max(np.abs(y-ref)/bound));assert r['max_bound_ratio']<=1,r
   results.append(r);print(json.dumps(r),flush=True)
   (p/'q4-refine-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
maps=Path('/proc/self/maps').read_text().splitlines()
libs=sorted(set(line.split()[-1] for line in maps if any(s in line for s in ['libcuda','libcublas','libq4_refine','libtorch'])))
(p/'q4-refine-libraries.json').write_text(json.dumps(libs,indent=2))
print('Q4_REFINE_SCREEN_PASS',len(results),libs,flush=True)
